description: AMR retune goals — Tier A own methods = paper_exact; Tier B TF ports = approximate (tracking −1.5/−1.0). Tracking pass/fail always uses tolerances.
split_protocol_note: CSRR default train/val/test = 5:1:4. For Tier A (MLDNN/FastMLDNN/HCGDNN) this matches paper-native protocol — do NOT blame split for residual gaps. For Tier B TF ports, 5:1:4 vs TF 6:2:2 may explain small gaps under approximate mode.

A_own_methods.note: Siege firepower focused here until paper-exact or documented waiver. Split 5:1:4 is paper-native — not a concession.

B_amr_benchmark_ports.note: TF Richardzhangxx/AMR-Benchmark ports. Approx OK; 5:1:4 vs TF 6:2:2 acceptable for remaining small gaps.

tracking_pass_rule.best_snr: informational only — does not fail a run

split_adjusted_targets.applies_to: Tier B RML ports only (not Tier A own methods)
split_adjusted_targets.rule: For Tier B RML sets: adjusted_overall = paper_overall - 2.5pp (mid of estimated 2–4 pp 5:1:4 vs TF 6:2:2). Do NOT apply to MLDNN/FastMLDNN/HCGDNN.

fastmldnn/deepsig201610A.split_adjusted_note: DISABLED for Tier A — 5:1:4 is paper-native; primary remains 63.24

hcgdnn/deepsig201610A.source: TWC HCGDNN / AMSCN-sourced overall; see own_methods_paper_alignment.md

campaign.priority: Tier A own three until paper-exact; deprioritize CLDNNW@2018 / ICAMCNet Hisar / other TF ports to approximate
campaign.waiver_requires: documented reason in retune_campaign.md or accuracy_tracking.md
